title: Native-consumer security boundary and DWG specification freshness
mode: Primary-source web research with bounded route-lineage review
scope: Review current Autodesk DWG/DXF security disclosures relevant to native-CAD acceptance testing.
Confirm the currently served official ODA DWG specification version.
Recheck whether newly surfaced application/tool routes add an independent DWG parser lineage.
Refine existing parser-safety and native-consumer qualification procedures without promoting peer reports into local defects or support claims.

sources.name: Autodesk ADSK-SA-2026-0009
sources.revision: Vendor advisory accessed 2026-10-20; originally published 2026-07-29 and last revised 2026-09-02.
sources.observed: Autodesk lists CVE-2026-16463, a malicious-DXF heap-based overflow, and CVE-2026-16465/CVE-2026-17550, malicious-DWG/DXF out-of-bounds reads. The advisory lists AutoCAD 2027 and named AutoCAD-based products as impacted, with 2027.1 as mitigated.
sources.limits: No public reproducer, entity/section root cause, or byte-level trigger is provided. This is not a libdxfrw vulnerability report or a DWG/DXF format specification.

sources.name: GitHub Advisory Database CVE-2026-16465
sources.observed: The database describes an out-of-bounds read in AutoCAD when parsing maliciously crafted DWG or DXF input and maps the report to CWE-125.
sources.limits: The advisory lists affected and patched versions as unknown and has no package or source-code linkage. The Autodesk vendor advisory is the product mitigation authority.

sources.name: Open Design Alliance official DWG specification PDF
sources.revision: Official download accessed 2026-10-20; PDF title page identifies version 5.4.1 and copyright 1998-2026.
sources.observed: The currently served official file remains version 5.4.1, matching the repository AGENTS.md authority for version-specific DWG layout questions.
sources.limits: A live download check does not prove that the document will not change; recheck its title/version when a later parser task requires authoritative byte-layout evidence.

sources.name: Newly surfaced project/tool route screen
sources.observed: No additional independent DWG parser lineage was identified: dwg-rs self-identifies as pre-alpha with entity coverage gaps; uncad documents LibreDWG via Rust FFI for DWG; OpenCADStudio is already grouped with the ACadRust lineage.
sources.limits: Documentation/lineage review only; none of these projects was built or executed.

ownersRefined: PAR-14: keep malformed DWG/DXF controls on local parser-safety lanes and avoid unsupported mutation hypotheses from advisory titles.
PAR-07/S8: treat native-CAD open/AUDIT as version-bound compatibility evidence, not a parser-security oracle.
Peer admission: preserve parser lineage and artifact binding; wrappers do not add independent parser votes.

limitations: The Autodesk advisory does not disclose a reproducer or byte-level trigger, so no local mutation or parser fix is inferred.
The ODA artifact check confirms the current version label only; DWG parser changes still require reading the relevant version-specific chapter.
Peer and native applications were not installed, built, or run.
No external DWG/DXF sample or PoC was downloaded or committed.
